response.sql: WITH per_item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(CAST(ili.derived_product_cost AS REAL) / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS line_count FROM Order_Items oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio, AVG(line_count) AS avg_line_items_per_order_item FROM per_item;
